home.title: Frequently Asked Questions
home.subtitle: Quick answers about Corporate Academy's courses, certifications, and scholarships.
home.q1: What courses does Corporate Academy offer?
home.a1: Corporate Academy offers 490+ professional technology courses across Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, and project management (PMP). Courses run in live online, self-paced, and hybrid formats, so you can learn around a full-time job.
home.q2: How many professionals has Corporate Academy trained?
home.a2: Corporate Academy has trained 63,000+ professionals since 2018, with alumni working at companies like Google, Accenture, Infosys, TCS, and SAP. Learner satisfaction averages 4.8 out of 5.
home.q3: Are Corporate Academy courses live or self-paced?
home.a3: Both. Most programmes are available as live online classes led by industry experts, and many also have self-paced and hybrid options. You choose the format at enrolment based on your schedule.
home.q4: Do I get a certification after completing a course?
home.a4: Yes. Every course leads to a globally recognized certification from Corporate Academy, and many programmes prepare you directly for vendor certifications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and PMP exams.
home.q5: Does Corporate Academy offer scholarships or discounts?
home.a5: Yes. Six scholarship types cover up to 50% of your course fee, including merit, financial-aid, women-in-tech, early-enrolment, and referral scholarships. Applications are free and decisions arrive within 48 business hours.
home.q6: Can I join a course with no IT background?
home.a6: Yes. Corporate Academy runs beginner-level tracks in every major category, and career counsellors help you pick a starting point. Working professionals from non-technical roles regularly transition into data, cloud, and ERP careers through these programmes.
home.q7: How do I contact Corporate Academy for course advice?
home.a7: Call +91-88001-82225 (English and Hindi support) or submit an enquiry on the website. A counsellor responds with course recommendations, batch dates, and fee details, typically within one business day.

courses.title: Course Catalog FAQs
courses.subtitle: Answers about fees, duration, formats, and certifications across the catalog.
courses.q1: How many courses does Corporate Academy have?
courses.a1: Corporate Academy's catalog has 490+ professional technology courses across Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, and PMP. New Course are added regularly as tools and certifications evolve.
courses.q2: How much does a course at Corporate Academy cost?
courses.a2: Fees vary by programme length and technology, and are quoted in INR when you enquire. Scholarships cover up to 50% of the fee for eligible learners, with decisions in 48 business hours, so most students pay significantly less than the listed price.
courses.q3: How long does a typical course take to complete?
courses.a3: Most courses take 20 to 60 hours of instruction, which works out to 4-10 weeks part-time alongside a job. Each course page lists the exact duration in hours plus the level (beginner, intermediate, or advanced).
courses.q4: Are the courses live online or self-paced?
courses.a4: Both formats are available. Live online courses run with expert instructors on fixed batch schedules, while self-paced courses let you learn on your own timeline; some programmes offer hybrid delivery combining the two.
courses.q5: Which course should I take as a complete beginner?
courses.a5: Start with a beginner-level course in the field you want to work in — filter the catalog by category and look for the 'Beginner' level badge. Data Science, Cloud Computing, and Salesforce are the most popular starting points for career changers with no prior IT experience.
courses.q6: Do the courses include a certification?
courses.a6: Yes. Every course ends with a globally recognized Corporate Academy certification, and many prepare you directly for vendor exams such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, AWS, and PMP. 63,000+ professionals have been certified through these programmes.

corporate.title: Corporate Training FAQs
corporate.subtitle: Answers about programme scope, delivery, measurement, and getting a proposal.
corporate.q1: Does Corporate Academy provide corporate training for companies?
corporate.a1: Yes. Corporate Academy designs customized workforce training programmes for companies, partnering with HR and L&D teams from capability-gap discovery through delivery and impact reporting. Programmes draw on a catalog of 490+ courses and the experience of training 63,000+ professionals.
corporate.q2: What topics can corporate training cover?
corporate.a2: Three programme families: technology capability (cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, DevOps, and platforms like Salesforce, Workday, and ServiceNow), leadership in practice for managers and future leaders, and workforce essentials covering high-impact business skills for every function.
corporate.q3: Can training be delivered to teams in multiple locations?
corporate.a3: Yes. Corporate Academy delivers consistently across multiple locations, regions, and time zones, combining live online sessions, in-person workshops, and self-paced reinforcement under one accountable partner.
corporate.q4: How is the impact of corporate training measured?
corporate.a4: Every engagement starts with a baseline skills map tied to business priorities, then tracks movement from baseline confidence to applied performance. Leadership teams receive an evidence trail with success measures agreed before delivery begins.
corporate.q5: Is there a minimum team size for corporate programmes?
corporate.a5: No fixed minimum. Learning paths are role-based and scale from a single team to an enterprise-wide rollout; the discovery phase sizes the programme to your capability gap and budget.
corporate.q6: How do we get a corporate training proposal?
corporate.a6: Submit the enquiry form on this page with your team size, goals, and timeline, or call +91-88001-82225. A programme consultant follows up with a discovery call and a tailored proposal, typically within two business days.

testimonialsSection.subtitle: Every scholar has a unique journey. Here are stories that inspire us every day.

1.text: The Merit Scholarship made it possible to enrol in the Data Science programme. Within 6 months I got placed at Infosys. Corporate Academy changed my life.

2.text: The Early Enrolment Scholarship pushed me to commit quickly and it was the best decision I made. My salary doubled within a year of completing the Workday course.

3.text: Returning to work after a career break felt daunting. The Women in Tech Scholarship showed me Corporate Academy genuinely invests in diverse talent.

4.text: Coming from a small town with limited resources, the Financial Aid Scholarship was a lifeline. Cleared AWS certification within 4 months of completing the course.

5.text: The Doctoral Scholarship signals that Corporate Academy values serious researchers. The programme is world-class and the faculty are genuine thought leaders.

6.text: I referred my colleague and we both got the Referral Scholarship. Studying together kept us motivated — we both cleared PMP on our first attempt.

eligible.title: Am I Eligible?
eligible.subtitle: Answer yes to any question below and you qualify for at least one scholarship. Just apply — our team finds the best match for you.
eligible.q1: Did you score 65% or above in your last qualification?
eligible.q2: Are you a woman looking to enter or return to the tech industry?
eligible.q3: Are you a first-generation college graduate or professional?
eligible.q4: Have you faced financial challenges limiting your education?
eligible.q5: Are you ready to enrol within the next 30 days?
eligible.q6: Do you have a friend or colleague who can enrol alongside you?
eligible.q7: Are you a senior professional pursuing a Doctorate / DBA?
eligible.q8: Are you passionate about building a better career?

1.q: Can I apply for more than one scholarship?
1.a: You can apply for all scholarships you are eligible for. Only the highest single discount applies. Referral and Early Enrolment can be stacked on top for additional savings.

2.q: Is there an income limit for the Financial Aid Scholarship?
2.a: No strict income cutoff. We assess applications holistically — your circumstances, motivation, and commitment matter more than a number.

3.q: How long does the process take?
3.a: You will receive a response within 48 business hours. Doctoral Research Scholarship may take up to 5 business days due to the proposal review.

4.q: Do I need to submit documents now?
4.a: No. The online form is sufficient for initial review. If shortlisted, we contact you for mark sheets or certificates. No uploads required at this stage.

5.q: Is the scholarship applicable to all courses?
5.a: Most scholarships apply to all full programmes. The Doctoral Scholarship is exclusive to DBA programmes. Applicability is confirmed in your offer letter.

6.a: Absolutely — all scholarships are open to both freshers and working professionals. The Doctoral Scholarship specifically requires 10+ years of experience.

7.q: What if my CGPA doesn't meet the Merit threshold?
7.a: You may still qualify for Financial Aid, Women in Tech, Early Enrolment, or Referral scholarships. Our committee looks at the full picture.

8.a: Once confirmed, you receive a unique scholarship code that applies the discount directly to your programme cost at the time of enrolment.
